dog.description_text:
Bert is a sweet, silly kitten!

Bert is eager to meet you and learn about all that life has in store. Despite his small size, Bert is confident and ready to take on every new adventure that comes his way.

Bert can often be seen alongside his littermate, Ernie. Whether for playtime or cuddles, he enjoys having a companion. He is FeLV-positive, but that doesn’t stop this bundle of joy from wanting to play, live and love like any other kitten would.

Bert is ready to find a loving home where he can continue growing, playing and enjoying all that life has to offer! Click the “Adopt Me” button to learn more about him.

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 6 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
